title: Three weeks with Tommy Dorsey
summary: He replaced Bill Finegan briefly and Dorsey did not like his work.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left

blocks.x: Yes. Bill had just been drafted and Tommy idolized Bill. I don't know how I came to go, but they needed-- they had Hugo Winterhalter and me, and before that it had been Bill. That lasted about three weeks; he didn't like what I did at all.
He was kind of an abrasive character, wasn't he?
Some people say yes and some people say no, but he just didn't like me and you can't do anything about that.
